secrets: Server memory only; every save replaces configuration including API key. No disk/database/browser storage, no save-time network request. Restart clears settings.
authentication: Existing Host/Origin/CSRF guards. Every POST requires current same-origin Origin, X-CSRF-Token, Content-Type: application/json.

limitations: No provider has been contacted by reading or saving settings.
Literal loopback, explicitly approved public HTTPS, or separately confirmed exact private IPv4 LAN HTTPS is supported.
Loopback transport does not prove inference stays local.
Only bounded case-linked evidence is analyzed. Notes, device identifiers and unrelated telemetry are excluded.
Evidence can still contain sensitive text; review the case and destination before starting.

body.baseURL: exact user-selected OpenAI-compatible base URL ending /v1 normally
body.apiKey: fresh key, <=4096 printable ASCII bytes; empty allowed only for literal loopback
body.approvedOrigin: exact scheme://authority of baseURL, no path
body.allowRemoteEvidence: boolean; must be true for public HTTPS
body.useLegacyMaxTokens: boolean; explicit compatibility choice, no automatic retries

POST /api/ai/config.response: same public shape as GET; never API key or fragment
POST /api/ai/config.effects: Construct/replace provider locally. Cancel prior in-flight analysis, retain global busy slot until cancellation settles. No network/DNS calls.

POST /api/ai/config/clear.response: default public config, new revision; in-flight old work canceled

body.baseURL: HTTPS URL with a literal RFC1918 IPv4 address and explicit port
body.apiKey: optional fresh key, <=4096 printable ASCII bytes; nonempty requires HTTPS operator access
body.approvedOrigin: exact HTTPS scheme://IPv4:port of baseURL, no path
body.allowRemoteEvidence: must be true, confirming evidence sharing
body.useLegacyMaxTokens: boolean; explicit compatibility choice, no automatic retries
body.acknowledgeLanDestination: must be true, confirming the exact LAN destination

POST /api/ai/config/lan.response: public configuration includes lanMode:true; never API key or fragment
POST /api/ai/config/lan.effects: Memory-only provider replaces prior settings and invalidates the proactive scope; no network/DNS request on save. TLS uses normal system trust and an IP SAN.

body.baseURL: HTTPS URL with a literal RFC1918 IPv4 address and explicit port
body.approvedOrigin: exact HTTPS scheme://IPv4:port of baseURL, no path
body.allowRemoteEvidence: must be true, confirming evidence sharing
body.acknowledgeLanDestination: must be true, confirming the exact LAN destination
body.caPem: one public self-signed CA certificate, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes
body.expectedCaSha256: independently verified lowercase SHA-256 of the CA DER
body.acknowledgeCaFingerprint: must be true after independent comparison

POST /api/ai/config/lan-private-ca.availability: Authenticated shared administrator through HTTPS only
POST /api/ai/config/lan-private-ca.response: public configuration adds lanPrivateCaSha256; no CA PEM or API key
POST /api/ai/config/lan-private-ca.effects: Process-memory-only exclusive trust for that CA and exact LAN origin; no provider contact on save. Explicit clear is required before replacing this provider.

body.configRevision: exact provider revision displayed to operator
body.acknowledgeTest: must be true for this single synthetic request

POST /api/ai/test.response: schemaVersion tracebolt.ai-provider-test.v1, original configRevision, and status passed|unavailable|timeout|invalid_response|canceled|busy; no model text or upstream errors
POST /api/ai/test.effects: One fixed synthetic request using the existing provider and global analysis slot. No stored case, device data or logs; no automatic retry, proactive approval or result persistence.

body.configRevision: exact revision last displayed to operator

POST /api/cases/{id}/analyze.effects: Explicit single provider request for existing server-loaded case/evidence only. No commands, fetching extra context, retries or fallback. No result persistence. With no provider returns rule baseline + ai.status not_configured.

body.baseURL: exact user-selected OpenAI-compatible base URL ending /v1 normally
body.apiKey: fresh key, <=4096 printable ASCII bytes; empty allowed only for literal loopback
body.approvedOrigin: exact scheme://authority of baseURL, no path
body.allowRemoteEvidence: boolean; must be true for public HTTPS
body.useLegacyMaxTokens: boolean; explicit compatibility choice, no automatic retries
body.acknowledgeKeyStorage: boolean; must be true for a nonempty key; keyed persistence requires HTTPS operator profile

POST /api/ai/config/persistent.availability: Authenticated shared administrator on complete Linux LAN manager with protected AI settings controller only
POST /api/ai/config/persistent.effects: Explicitly persist exact provider and fresh key if separately acknowledged; invalidate prior proactive scope. No provider/DNS call.

analysisResult.superseded: true if configuration changed while request ran; UI must ignore outdated completion
analysisResult.packet: See internal/analysis/packet.go; bounded selected evidence with source/time/quality/synthetic metadata

uiRules: Never persist API keys in browser storage. Clear the password input after an accepted save; never fill it from GET. Every save requires fresh entry where a key is needed.
Show the exact selected destination and evidence-sharing explanation before explicit analyze. Require remote-evidence opt-in for HTTPS outside loopback.
Ignore old navigation responses and mismatched/superseded config results. Keep deterministic baseline separate from model suggestions.
Do not label settings saved as a successful provider connection or model test.
Configuration and results are memory-only and reset on restart/reload respectively.
persistenceExtension: Complete Linux LAN managers optionally support explicit protected provider+scope persistence; see ai-settings-persistence.md. No automatic migration; key storage additionally acknowledged and HTTPS-only. Local development remains memory-only.
